title: Ad Tracking & Targeted Advertising Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Template letter to request information about ad tracking and opt-out of targeted advertising. Protect your privacy with this customizable template.
description: Use this template to formally request information about how companies track your online behavior for advertising purposes and to opt-out of targeted advertising programs. Includes placeholders for personal information and specific tracking concerns.

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Request for Information Regarding Ad Tracking and Opt-Out from Targeted Advertising

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to request information about your company's ad tracking practices and to exercise my rights regarding targeted advertising. As a consumer concerned about my digital privacy, I would like to understand how my personal data is being collected and used for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Information Request
sections.content:
Please provide the following information:

1. What types of tracking technologies (cookies, pixels, device fingerprinting, etc.) does your company use?
2. What personal information do you collect for advertising purposes?
3. How do you track my behavior across websites and devices?
4. Which third-party advertising partners do you share my data with?
5. How long do you retain my advertising-related data?
6. What measures do you take to protect my personal information from unauthorized access?

sections.heading: Opt-Out Request
sections.content:
I hereby request to opt-out of:

• All targeted advertising based on my personal data
• Behavioral advertising and profiling
• Cross-device tracking
• Sharing of my personal information with third-party advertisers
• Creation of advertising profiles based on my online activity

Please confirm that you have processed this opt-out request and provide instructions for maintaining these preferences.

sections.heading: Account Information
sections.content:
To help you locate my records, my account information is as follows:

Account Email: [Your Email]
Account Username: [Username if applicable]
Customer ID: [Customer ID if known]

If you need additional information to verify my identity, please contact me using the information provided above.

sections.heading: Legal Rights Reference
sections.content:
I am making this request under applicable privacy laws, including but not limited to:

• California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
• General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
• Other applicable state and federal privacy regulations

I understand that I have the right to know what personal information is collected, how it is used, and to opt-out of the sale or sharing of my personal information for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content: Please respond to this request within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws. If you need additional time or information to process this request, please contact me promptly to discuss.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response and confirmation that my opt-out preferences have been implemented.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
